guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Rust doc comments cover the new reference-model types, constructors, and getters in src/features/transformation/domain/mod.rs and src/features/weekly_radar/runtime/model.rs.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not import internal modules from other features.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The runtime uses public transformation-domain types and the architecture/dependency tests pass.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep provider-specific parsing outside the domain and keep the reference-model gate provider-neutral and deterministic.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Provider adapters attach typed metadata; eligibility is evaluated by the pure bundle gate in src/features/transformation/domain/mod.rs.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use typed evidence families and explicit provenance instead of inferring eligibility from arbitrary text or scores.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: ReferenceModelEvidenceFamily, provenance, named peers, and bounded periods are carried through EvidenceCandidate, ValidatedEvidence, and NormalizedFact.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Prefer false negatives to promoting an organization announcement, marketing claim, or page-level observation as a reference model.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Page-level observations and incomplete Candidate packets are excluded from Confirmed eligibility and REFERENCE_MODEL Stage; negative fixtures pass.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Require at least two distinct dated outcome periods and independent diffusion sources; a single source or single period is insufficient.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The domain gate enforces two distinct periods and two independent diffusion URIs with named peers; boundary tests pass.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, CounterEvidence, and MissingProof as different states.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: SEC ambiguity remains UNKNOWN, source health remains separate, counter review is explicit, and missing family requirements render as MissingProof.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use Python and Shell only for bounded orchestration, fixtures, and verification; do not place business judgment in scripts.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Python/Shell were used only for bounded runs and checks; Rust owns classification, gate evaluation, Stage suppression, serialization, and report values.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve legacy snapshot deserialization and localized semantic-splitter compatibility.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Legacy JSON defaults and Chinese/Japanese/English report and splitter tests pass.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Resolve in-scope defects in this Work Item; do not create another Work Item merely to avoid a failing hard gate.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: SEC ambiguity, historical fixtures, stale installer hashes, and all affected knowledge projections were repaired in this Work Item and rechecked.

summary.text: Added a typed four-family reference-model evidence gate, then iterated live discovery and extraction until a bounded Microsoft packet passed the gate.

mechanism.text: The gate requires authoritative organization and production rewrites, multi-period sustained outcomes, independent named-peer diffusion, and an explicit bounded counter review before Confirmed eligibility can expose REFERENCE_MODEL Stage.

evidence.subject: Candidate suppression and Confirmed Stage gate

affectedComponents.component: Weekly Radar evidence and runtime models
affectedComponents.detail: Typed family, named-peer, and bounded-period metadata is backward-compatible with legacy JSON.
Distinct historical outcome periods are retained without duplicating fact identity, while latest-period ambiguity remains UNKNOWN.
Localized reports expose the four-family matrix, eligibility, missing proof, counter review, and source distinctions.
Configured Microsoft Inside Track and customer-story URLs are fetched as documents, with content-path priority and visible publication-date parsing preventing page-level and undated false negatives.

evidence.subject: bounded content discovery and date extraction
direct official document and publication-date regressions

designDecisions.decision: Keep Candidate distinct from Confirmed and never call Candidate an exemplar.
designDecisions.reason: The product target is an AI-era industry model, so incomplete organization stories must remain visibly incomplete.

designDecisions.decision: Keep Ranking unchanged and gate only the highest REFERENCE_MODEL Stage.
designDecisions.reason: Evidence quality is the bottleneck; ranking must not compensate for missing proof.

evidence.subject: ranking isolation and reference Stage gate

technicalDetails.detail: Rust, Python, clippy, formatting, knowledge projection, strict Cockpit quality, and a bounded Microsoft live run pass; the live packet is Confirmed only under the explicit four-family policy.

evidence.claim: Evidence extraction preserves typed family metadata and provenance.
evidence.subject: evidence extraction and metadata tests

evidence.claim: Judgment suppresses incomplete reference-model Stage and localized reports preserve the matrix.
evidence.subject: judgment and localized report tests

evidence.claim: The bounded Microsoft run produced organization rewrite, production-system rewrite, four outcome periods, two named-peer diffusion URIs, and completed counter review.
evidence.subject: 2026-08-25 bounded Microsoft reference-model validation run

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Complete four-family bundle becomes a confirmed reference-model assessment.
Organization and production-system claims without outcome or diffusion remain candidates.
Self-description or page-level availability cannot satisfy the gate.
Two distinct outcome periods and independent diffusion sources are required.
Legacy snapshots, localized reports, and Python/Shell orchestration remain compatible.
A live bounded run produces an evidence matrix and does not fabricate a confirmed exemplar.

unknownsRemaining: A ten-company live public-network run was not completed because acquisition waited beyond the bounded observation window; deterministic and single-company runs completed.
The confirmed diffusion packet is based on Microsoft-published customer stories naming PwC and NIQ; independent non-Microsoft publisher corroboration was not assessed by this bounded run.

risk.detail: ReferenceModel is the strongest product claim; false promotion is prevented by four evidence families, two outcome periods, two independent diffusion URIs with named peers, authority, cutoff, counter review, and missing-proof gates.

observedIssues.issue: SEC latest-period ambiguity regressed during multi-period implementation
observedIssues.resolution: Latest ambiguity now returns no selected annual periods, preserving UNKNOWN; older periods are considered only after a unique latest period.

observedIssues.issue: Ten-company live run had no incremental output during public-network waits
observedIssues.resolution: Run was terminated after bounded observation; single-company runs verified report rendering. Remaining operational risk is recorded rather than hidden.

observedIssues.issue: Discovery budget was consumed by generic navigation before relevant Microsoft articles
observedIssues.resolution: Content paths and document kinds now receive deterministic priority before the bounded candidate cap; regression coverage prevents navigation starvation.

observedIssues.issue: Explicit customer-story URLs remained entrypoints and undated pages could not promote claims
observedIssues.resolution: Explicit content URLs are promoted to documents and visible M/D/YYYY dates are parsed without guessing other date formats.

observedIssues.issue: The runtime had no distinct counter-review record and leaked its marker into Companies to Watch
observedIssues.resolution: A bounded review marker is separate from counter claims, the assessment exposes review status, and internal judgment facts are excluded from user-facing company observations.
